body.label: Effect
body.html: Gain +1 Defense until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Increase one Defense bonus from this card by 1.
Your next Guard Reaction before the start of your next turn may commit 1 fewer die, minimum 2.

rider.title: GUARD — STANCE
rider.html: Enter Crane Stance. While in this Stance, reduce forced movement against you by 1 unit. Entering another Stance replaces it; becoming Prone ends it.
